votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 5 of 2021 amending the final Budget for Fiscal Year 2021-22 of the Local Building Authority of Salt Lake City, Utah (D-1: Sales Tax Series 2012A Refunding of LBA Bonds – $10,500,000)
votes.description: Amends the LBA's FY2021-22 budget, specifically the Capital Projects Fund covering bond debt service for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries.

votes.motion: Approve the Tuesday November 9, 2021 and November 16, 2021 Work Session and Formal Meeting Minutes
votes.description: Approves the official minutes from the November 9 and November 16, 2021 Work Session and Formal Council meetings.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and refer Items E-1 through E-7 to a future Consent Agenda for action
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on seven grant applications and refers them to a future consent agenda for formal action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 69 of 2021 limiting new commercial or industrial land uses to an annual average of 200,000 gallons of potable water per day, with legislative intents regarding water conservation policy review and NWQ development agreements
votes.description: Adopts a zoning text amendment restricting significant water-consuming commercial and industrial land uses, sets a 200,000 gallon per day limit, and initiates legislative actions for further water conservation policy review and NWQ development agreement adherence.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer action on the Master Plan Amendment and Rezone at 129 South 700 East and 758 East Bueno Avenue to a future Council meeting
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed rezone of Bueno Avenue properties from SR-3 to RMF-45 and defers final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer action on the Rezone at Redwood Road and Indiana Avenue to a future Council meeting
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed rezone of properties at Redwood Road and Indiana Avenue from R-1/5,000 to R-MU-45 and defers final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer action on the Ordinance allowing commercial uses on rooftops which exceed 2 stories to a future Council meeting
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed FB-SE zoning amendment allowing rooftop commercial uses above the second story and defers final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and adopt Ordinance 70 of 2021 pertaining to the Alley Vacation at 1200 Block of Kensington and Bryan Avenues
votes.description: Closes the public hearing and adopts an ordinance vacating a portion of the City-owned alley in the 1200 block of Kensington and Bryan Avenues for incorporation into adjacent properties.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and adopt Ordinance 71 of 2021 pertaining to the Columbus Street Alley Vacation North of Victory Road
votes.description: Closes the public hearing and adopts an ordinance vacating a portion of the City-owned alley adjacent to properties on Columbus Street north of Victory Road.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer the City Consent to Subleases at The Leonardo to a future date for action
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed resolution authorizing subleases at The Leonardo and defers final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Reconsider the vote on the City Consent to Subleases at The Leonardo item
votes.description: Moves to reconsider the prior vote that deferred action on The Leonardo sublease consent resolution, allowing the Council to take up the item again immediately.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and adopt Resolution 50 of 2021 providing consent to sublease at The Leonardo
votes.description: Adopts a resolution authorizing sublease arrangements at The Leonardo, finding they fulfill a public purpose and comply with outstanding bond requirements.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 72 of 2021 pertaining to the Sugar House Business District Design Standards Zoning Text Amendment
votes.description: Adopts a zoning text amendment incorporating design guidelines from the Sugar House Master Plan into the Sugar House Business District zone, covering building facade design, doorway spacing, glass transparency, and public way improvements.

votes.motion: Reject the proposed ordinance to amend the zoning of the property at 1945 South 1300 East from RMF-35 to RMF-45
votes.description: Denies the petition to rezone 1945 South 1300 East to a higher-density multifamily residential district.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 73 of 2021 amending City Code relating to the EPA Revisions to Sewer Regulations (Pretreatment Affirmative Defense Provision), to take effect at the completion of the subsequent State regulatory process
votes.description: Adopts housekeeping amendments to the City's Sewer Pretreatment Program to align City Code language with updated federal technical requirements, with no change to regulatory practice.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda (Grant Holding Account Items Batch No.3 Associated with BAM No.5 for Fiscal Year 2021-22)
votes.description: Approves grant holding account items in the third batch associated with Budget Amendment No. 5 for FY2021-22.
